## What this lands

- **`web/tests/e2e/capstone-per-ask.spec.ts`** — the U-003.1…11 battery:
  13 named acceptance checks walked once per {1440, 390 px} × {JS on,
  JS off} cell. Every check resolves its targets from the served site
  itself — the A–Z directory supplies the dossier routes (canonical
  `/dossier/usa/` paths preferred), the `/sources/` table supplies the
  published source rows, the `web/dossier_sources` artifact supplies the
  contribution breakdown, the research queue supplies the task handles —
  nothing fixture-specific is hard-coded, so the identical spec runs
  against the promoted origin with `SIG_CAPSTONE_BASE_URL`. Highlights:
  the map's self-hosted style contract + located-record map-embed +
  no-JS limit (U-003.1); a bounded UUID-label crawl + named entities +
  dated-or-undated edges (U-003.2); the GET/no-JS search form +
  `sig.search-index/1` / `sig.typeahead-shard/1` machinery + honest empty
  results (U-003.3); country → state/subdivision grouping + "Not yet
  placed" (U-003.4); the "from N sources" figure reconciled to the
  artifact's per-source sum + execution-keyed first/last-seen run history
  (U-003.5); dossier Figure 1 + scoped search (U-003.6); watch pages +
  validating feeds (U-003.7); evidence rows with binding states
  (U-003.8); the no-JS sortable sources table + honest gated/withheld row
  states (U-003.9); the full per-source record — rights, conduct,
  execution-keyed runs, hashed captures, dossier contribution, changelog
  (U-003.10); and the research queue — canonical task id → `T-` handle
  via 301-or-alias-stub, ≤50 cards, explicit drafts never sent
  (U-003.11).
- **`web/playwright.capstone-consolidated.config.ts`** — the dedicated
  four-project runner (`capstone-1440-js`, `capstone-390-js`,
  `capstone-1440-nojs`, `capstone-390-nojs`).
  `SIG_CAPSTONE_BASE_URL=<promoted-origin>` skips the preview server and
  points the battery at the promoted release — a fixture/preview pass is
  never reported as a live/public pass. The spec also runs once inside
  the ordinary `test:e2e` pass so a regression fails in CI.
- **`ops/src/ops/capstone_consolidated.py` + `sig-ops
  capstone-consolidated`** — the `sig.capstone-consolidated/1` leg
